decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The conversion of roof space into a habitable room incorporating the installation of roof lights to the front and rear elevations and internal alterations, as shown on drawings '04 Existing Plan, 05 Proposed Plans, 06 Copy of proposed side elevation', Received 11th May 2006, is satisfactory as it is considered that the proposal would be compatible with the existing dwelling, maintain the amenity of the neighbouring properties and preserves and enhances the appearance and character of the Stamford Brook Conservation Area. The development is in accordance with the London Borough of Hounslow's Unitary Development Plan (2003) and is compliant with Councils Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Conversion of roof space to a habitable room incorporating rooflights and internal alterations to house.
